catalysts.headline: SELLAS to present SLS009 (tambiciclib) data at the American Society of Hematology (ASH) annual meeting
catalysts.impact: Key data readout venue for SLS009 in relapsed/refractory and newly diagnosed AML

catalysts.headline: SELLAS announced it will present positive Phase 2 data for SLS009 (tambiciclib) combination therapy in high-risk AML at ASH 2026 (New Orleans, Dec 12-15; one outlet cites a Dec 14 presentation date): among evaluable patients at the selected dose, a 54% response rate with 5.8-month median survival in monocytic AML, and a 57% response rate with 8.8-month median survival in TP53-mutated AML, versus a cited historical benchmark of ~2.5 months for each subgroup. Analysts note the absence of a concurrent comparator arm means these figures do not establish a survival benefit on their own.

Presented Phase 2 results for SLS009 (tambiciclib) in relapsed/refractory AML: across doses, 34% of 59 evaluable patients responded; independent observers noted the single-arm data do not by themselves demonstrate a survival benefit
catalysts.impact: Shares rose 3% to $9.14 on the news day but were still down nearly 6% for the week

catalysts.headline: Completed Phase 2 data for SLS009 (tambiciclib) in relapsed/refractory AML; company has previously stated the trial met all primary endpoints and that it received FDA guidance to advance into a first-line (newly diagnosed) AML study
Completed Phase 2 data for SLS009 (tambiciclib) in relapsed/refractory AML to be presented at ASH 2026 (Dec 12-15, New Orleans); frontline Phase 2 data expected Q4 2026

Phase 3 REGAL trial of galinpepimut-S (GPS) in AML reached its pre-specified 80th death event, triggering database lock, unblinding and final statistical analysis of the overall-survival primary endpoint; topline results expected later in Q4 2026
catalysts.impact: Shares fell ~18% per one source (TIKR, updated 2026-10-28); a separate source (Insider Monkey) reports a ~13% decline tied to the same news — not reconciled

catalysts.headline: Licensing partner 3D Medicines reports the Phase 3 REGAL (galinpepimut-S) trial event count at 78 of the 80 pre-specified events as of this settlement date; final analysis is triggered once the 80th event occurs
